CustomField.description: TNCI-139 / ELV-CPQ-036. Prorate-multiplier variant of ELV_ARR_Amount__c. Step 1: exclusion gate repointed to line-local ELV_Product_Exclude_from_ARR__c. Step 2: pricing-schedule test repointed from ISBLANK(ELV_Tanium_Pricing_Schedule__c) to the stored checkbox ELV_Has_Tanium_Pricing_Schedule__c so no lookup reference remains and the formula is deterministic for roll-up summarization. Logic unchanged; checkbox maintained by ELV_QuoteLineTriggerUtility before insert/update.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ELV_Product_Exclude_from_ARR__c, ELV_Exclude_from_ARR__c, ISPICKVAL( Ruby__LineType__c, "SummaryItem" ), ELV_ProrateMultiplier__c = 0 ), 0.00, IF( ELV_Has_Tanium_Pricing_Schedule__c, ( ELV_Unit_Price_Variance__c * Ruby__ActualQuantity__c ) / ELV_ProrateMultiplier__c, ( Ruby__NetSalesPrice__c * Ruby__ActualQuantity__c ) / ELV_ProrateMultiplier__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Annualized line amount. 0.00 when excluded from ARR or on a Summary Item.
CustomField.label: ARR Amount (Prorate Multiplier)
